en: Dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor an object of clinging (*nasaraṇa-nasārammaṇa*). (Abbreviated. One [condition] by way of root (*hetu*) ... pe ... five by way of non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor mind (*nasaraṇa-nacitta*) ... (Abbreviated. Five by way of root, two by way of object (*ārammaṇa*) ... pe ... one by way of result (*vipāka*) ... pe ... five by way of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor mental concomitant (*nasaraṇa-nacetasika*) ... (Abbreviated. Three by way of root, one by way of object ... pe ... three by way of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not associated with consciousness … (Abbreviated) … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not conjoined with consciousness … (Abbreviated). Under root condition: one … up to … under non-disappearance condition: one.
Dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not produced by consciousness … (Abbreviated). Under root condition: one … up to … under non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not co-existent with consciousness … (Abbreviated) … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not following consciousness … (Abbreviated). Under root condition: three; under object condition: one … up to … under non-disappearance condition: three.

Dependent on a state that is not a refuge, not conjoined with mind, and not co-originated … pe … dependent on a state that is not a refuge, not conjoined with mind, and co-existent … pe … dependent on a state that is not a refuge, not conjoined with mind, and concomitant … (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are three; under object-condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are three.
Dependent on a state that is neither internal nor subjective … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: five; under object-condition: two … pe … under resultant-condition:
one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: five. Dependent on a state that is neither internal nor external … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is neither internal nor derived … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: four; under object-condition: two … pe … under resultant-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: four.

Dependent on a state that is neither subject to clinging nor grasped (*nasaraṇaṃ naupādinnam*), ... (abbreviated). Under the root condition (*hetu*) there are five; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*) there are two ... pe ... under the result condition (*vipāka*) there is one ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are five.

Dependent on a state that is neither subject to clinging nor not grasped (*nasaraṇaṃ naanupādinnam*), ... (abbreviated). Under the root condition there is one ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there is one.
